'''April 2000 Olympia tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Olympia, Washington on 1 April 2000. [[Walter Zylowski]] won it. It is known from Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d458">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-04-olympia-washington-4-1-00d458/ olympia-washington-4-1-00], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 4 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-04-olympia-washington-4-1-00d458/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Olympia, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Walter Zylowski]]
